profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Samsara
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer focused on full-stack platform engineering, AI-enabled workflows, enterprise integrations, and cloud infrastructure. I build scalable platforms using TypeScript, Python, Angular, React, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS, Azure, and modern LLM tooling, with experience supporting systems used across large enterprise environments. I also maintain Prettify TypeScript, a VS Code extension with 81k+ installs, and contribute to open source projects including GraphiQL.

https://github.com/mylesmmurphy
